messages:
oliver: Tiny heads-up from todaywhile onboarding magnet-32k int4: observed intermittent duplication when we do a prefill (~11.9k) then an append (~7.5k) then resume. Dup runs are small (3-8 toks) and KV fingerprint changes post-append. ~1/250 runs.

rhea: Which pool? Dedicated QA or perf-lab? Any quick logs?

oliver: ded-qa-2. Minimal failing snippet: 

```
[cache] prefill id=0xdeadbeef fp=0x0f12 len=11904 slot=14
[cache] append id=0xdeadbef0 fp=0x0f13 len+=7680 slot=14
gen: step=11910 token=345 dup_detect idx=11907-11911
[cache] fp_mismatch expected=0x0f12 got=0x0f13
```

samir: If reset policy fixes it that points to fold/merge bug. Did you try kv_policy=reset?

oliver: Yes, reset always fixes but costs ~18-22ms P50. Not acceptable for low-latency flows.

anya: Could be RoPE phasing continuity problem when stitching prefilled slots with live inflight cache. Or a race that updates metadata without a proper memory barrier. Which arch did you hit this on?

oliver: repro on both x86 and arm64 but slightly more frequent on arm64.

rhea: Two next steps: 1) add deterministic microbench (seeded RNG) that runs the prefill-append-resume pattern for 50k iterations on qemu with quantized kernels; 2) try a scoped lock around append->merge to see if race is root cause. If lock eliminates repro, optimize later with CAS.

samir: Also add slot/epoch dumps on failure so we can diff pre/post append slot contents. That should reveal any miswrites or off-by-one shifts.

ci-bot: Created issue #4622: "magnet32k: intermittent append-fingerprint-drift during fold" (reporter: oliver) :bug:

anya: Bonus experiment: toggle the stitcher to force continuous pos offset vs re-evaluated pos embeddings during append. If forcing continuity removes dup, it's RoPE-related. If no change, it's likely metadata race.

oliver: Uploaded repro script and token snapshots to /artifacts/magnet32k/repro-2791234567.tar.gz. I'll run the 50k deterministic run tomorrow morning and report results. :eyes:
